source: 外研社版必修第二册 Unit 6 同主题完形(校园环保行动/家中节电/守护海洋/光盘行动/河边植树/骑车上学)。用词限 U6/初中/常见词,每空4选项同词性、答案唯一,与阅读听力关不复用文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: Going Green at School
passages.text: Our school has started a new project to help the (1)____. Last week, our teacher gave a (2)____ about climate change and asked us to take action. On sunny days, our classroom uses (5)____ power from panels on the roof, so we save a lot of (6)____. Before we leave, we always (7)____ off the lights and computers. We have also planted young trees in the (8)____ behind the gym, because trees take in carbon dioxide. Our teacher says that even small actions can (9)____ a lot to a greener world. I feel (10)____ that I am doing something useful for the Earth.

passages.title: Saving Energy at Home
passages.text: Many people think that switching off a (1)____ such as a television means it stops using power. In fact, this is not always (2)____. passages.title: The Clear Your Plate Campaign
passages.text: Last month, our class started a (1)____ called Clear Your Plate. Its goal is to (2)____ people to stop wasting food. passages.title: Planting Trees by the River
